opt.daemon_port.hint: 47654 is this Windows session's client. Another port (47655) is a client in its own session: a profile naming it drives the SECOND account.
opt.debug_send_url.hint: URL the debug-log archive is sent to. Empty — do not send. A stub for now — no transport is wired.

opt.sweep_radius.hint: Half the side of the box around the centre.
opt.sweep_rest_min.hint: The map does not change fast enough to walk passes back to back.
opt.sweep_step.hint: Shorter than a screen: an extra jump is cheaper than a band of tiles nobody asked about.
opt.trace_filter.hint: Display filter for the panel log ONLY — the recording on disk always keeps every call. A substring of the Lua function name; «SFS» covers the whole wire. Widening it (e.g. «Manager», «Util») only shows more of what is already on disk, but tens of thousands of lines a second can still freeze the panel log — leave it narrow. Empty shows everything.

profile.label: Profile:
rally.no_squads: no squad is ticked — tick them in Settings → Auto-rally
rally_limit.frame: Daily rally caps by monster type
rally_limit.hint: How many rallies of each type auto-join may join per day. 0 = no cap. The count resets daily.
rally_tab.frame: Raise a rally on a world monster
rally_tab.hint: Each ticked squad raises its own rally on the chosen target of the chosen level, N times over. Levels run 1–200 for both targets — seasonal events put high-level monsters on the map — and a level the game has nothing for simply comes back empty. The «monster» daily cap (Settings → Auto-rally) is honoured. A repeat only counts once the game shows the new rally. The buttons beside the box are the levels rallied at most often — one press each. All four choices are kept in the profile and are back the next time the panel opens.

timers.editor.steps_hint: Steps, one per line. A line is either the name of an action script or DSL right here («TAP donate_1000 xall»). They run in order; a failed step abandons the rest, and the retry does the whole errand again.
timers.editor.title: Label in the list:
timers.hint: A ticked errand runs itself once its period has passed; the clock survives a restart — an hour that elapsed with the panel shut fires shortly after it opens. Nothing fires with the game closed; a failed run is not counted and is retried; two errands due at the same moment take their turn rather than going together. The list belongs to the profile: edit it with the buttons below — «⟳» re-reads the file if you edited it outside.

secrettasks.hint: The STARRED alliance secret tasks, read live from the game, each with a countdown to when it becomes raidable. When the countdown hits zero the row lights up: the tile can be robbed, and with «Автолут ★» ticked it is robbed on its own. Switch on «secret_task_share» in the Triggers list to have a mate's share appear here too.
secrettasks.empty: no starred task — press Refresh (needs the game running)
secrettasks.collect_fail: collect not sent — daily limit spent or no game
cmdpost.no_game: nothing read — needs the daemon and a running game
cmdpost.ghost.title: Ghost Operation
cmdpost.ghost.hint: The squads of the weekly Ghost Operation — the game knows them all, so no map sweep is needed. A robbery is one message, no window and no march: the button shows only on the squads the game itself calls robbable. The event runs one day a week; on the other days the list is empty and every press is held. No live robbery has happened yet — the event was shut when this was written.
cmdpost.ghost.closed_empty: the event is shut today — nothing to rob
cmdpost.ghost.log_held: robbery held ({uuid}) — event shut, budget spent or no game
cmdpost.shared.title: Shared Squad Missions
cmdpost.shared.hint: The secret tasks an alliancemate shares. Nothing is polled: the share arrives as a broadcast the moment someone presses it, so this page listens to the wire. Without «rob on sight» it only lists what it hears; with it, a mission matching the rule is robbed in a fraction of a second. The five-a-day budget is shared with every other secret-task robbery.
cmdpost.shared.empty: nobody has shared anything yet — tick «Listen» and wait
cmdpost.shared.log_on: listening — waiting for an alliancemate to share a secret task
cmdpost.shared.log_held: robbery held ({uuid}) — budget spent or no game
cmdpost.treasure.title: Hidden Treasures
cmdpost.treasure.hint: The chests an alliance's radar drops on the map. Nothing appears by itself: «Refresh» asks the server for the list, reads the answer and parks what came back — an empty list means there is nothing to dig right now. While a chest is being dug the chosen squad can join the dig; once it is dug, the reward can be taken. No live radar event has put a chest out yet, so both presses are built but unproven.
cmdpost.treasure.info: treasures the client knows: {n} · taken today — {daily}
cmdpost.treasure.empty: no treasure on the map — press «Refresh» (the radar event is not always on)
cmdpost.treasure.log_dig: a squad is on its way to dig ({uuid})
cmdpost.treasure.log_failed: not sent ({uuid}) — the treasure is gone, the day's limit is spent or the game is not running
cmdpost.treasure.log_no_squad: squad {squad} is not loaded — nobody to send digging
cmdpost.scan_on: listening to the map for {n}s — pan the camera (or tick «Автообъезд карты» on the Secret Tasks tab), or no tile will arrive
